task: In Production, create an experiment metric named "signup_completed" that records whether the event "signup_completed" happened at least once per user. Higher is better.
finalText: DONE: Created experiment metric "signup_completed" (id 26) in Production (environment key dnybE3ywRgu6enEmAFw6Uc) with aggregation "occurrence" (happened at least once per user), direction "up" (higher is better), and definition {"version": 1, "event": "signup_completed"}. I verified it is the only metric in that environment; the "event" definition key is my best guess at the schema, since the API accepted it but doesn't document it.
commands: flagsmith --help; echo; flagsmith --help 2>&1 | head -0; for c in $(flagsmith --help 2>/dev/null | awk '/Commands:/{f=1;next} f&&NF{print $1}'); do echo "== $c"; done
flagsmith api --help; flagsmith config; flagsmith environment --help; flagsmith feature --help | head -40
flagsmith environment list; flagsmith api api/v1/metrics/ 2>&1 | head -c 1000; echo; flagsmith api api/v1/experiments/ 2>&1 | head -c 1000; echo; flagsmith api api/v1/projects/74/ 2>&1 | head -c 1500

flagsmith api api/v1/schema/ 2>&1 | head -c 300; echo; flagsmith api api/v1/docs/ 2>&1 | head -c 200; echo; for p in api/v1/metrics/ api/v1/experiment-metrics/ api/v1/projects/74/metrics/ api/v1/environments/dnybE3ywRgu6enEmAFw6Uc/metrics/ api/v1/experiments/metrics/; do echo "== $p"; flagsmith api $p --json 2>&1 | head -c 300; echo; done

flagsmith api api/v1/docs/ 2>&1 | grep -oE '(href|src|url)[=:]["'"'"' ]*[^"'"'"' ]*' | sort -u | head -30; for p in api/v1/openapi.json api/v1/swagger.json api/v1/schema.json api/v1/openapi/ api/v1/docs/schema.json; do echo "== $p"; flagsmith api $p 2>&1 | head -c 150; echo; done

flagsmith api api/v1/swagger.json > /tmp/swag.json; jq -r '.paths | keys[]' /tmp/swag.json | grep -i -E 'metric|experiment'; jq -r '.components.schemas | keys[]' /tmp/swag.json | grep -i -E 'metric|experiment'

jq -r '.paths | to_entries[] | select(.key|test("metric")) | .key as $k | (.value|to_entries[]| "\(.key) \($k) \(.value.operationId)")' /tmp/swag.json; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/metrics/"].post' /tmp/swag.json; jq '.components.schemas.AggregationEnum, .components.schemas.DirectionEnum, .components.schemas.ExpectedDirectionEnum' /tmp/swag.json

flagsmith api api/v1/environments/dnybE3ywRgu6enEmAFw6Uc/experiment-metrics/ 2>&1 | head -c 1500; echo; jq '.components.schemas | to_entries[] | select(.key|test("Metric|Experiment")) | {k:.key, d:(.value.description // "")}' /tmp/swag.json | head -60; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiment-metrics/"].post.description, .components.schemas.MetricItem' /tmp/swag.json

grep -n -i 'definition' /tmp/swag.json | head -30; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/dnybE3ywRgu6enEmAFw6Uc/metrics/ 2>&1 | head -c 600; echo; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/dnybE3ywRgu6enEmAFw6Uc/experiments/ 2>&1 | head -c 600

for v in '"1"' 1 '"v1"' '"1.0"'; do echo "== $v"; printf '{"name":"signup_completed","description":"x","aggregation":"occurrence","direction":"up","definition":{"version":%s,"event":"signup_completed"}}' "$v" | flagsmith api api/v1/environments/dnybE3ywRgu6enEmAFw6Uc/experiment-metrics/ -X POST --input - 2>&1 | head -3; done

flagsmith api api/v1/environments/dnybE3ywRgu6enEmAFw6Uc/experiment-metrics/ --json | jq '.results[] | {id,name,aggregation,direction,definition,experiments}'; echo; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/dnybE3ywRgu6enEmAFw6Uc/experiment-metrics/ --json | jq .count
